en.text: There is a persistent increase in the price level.

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 28 題

en.text: Which of the following can explain why a long run aggregate supply curve is vertical?

zh.text: 下列哪項／些能夠解釋為什麼長期總供應曲線是垂直的？

en.text: Input prices can be perfectly adjusted in the long run.

zh.text: 投入的價格在長期可被完全調整。

en.text: Firms are unable to adjust their output levels in the long run.

zh.text: 廠商在長期無法調整其產出水平。

en.text: Technological level is not constant in the long run.

zh.text: 科技水平在長期不是固定的。
香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 29 題

en.text: In an economy, a large number of workers migrate overseas together with their family members. In the short run, the price level of the economy ______ and its real output ______.

zh.text: 在某經濟中，大量工人攜同他們的家人移民海外。在短期，該經濟的物價水平____，而該經濟的實質產出____。

en.text: will fall ... may rise or fall

zh.text: 會下降……可能上升或下降

en.text: may rise or fall ... will fall

zh.text: 可能上升或下降……會下降

en.text: may rise or fall ... may rise or fall

zh.text: 可能上升或下降……可能上升或下降
香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 37 題

en.text: The following diagram shows the short run aggregate supply (SRAS) curves of a country.

zh.text: 下圖顯示某國的短期總供應（SRAS）曲線。

en.text: Which of the following is a possible reason of the above shift of the SRAS curve?

zh.text: 下列哪一項是上述 SRAS 曲線移動的可能原因？

en.text: The transportation cost of factor inputs rises.

zh.text: 生產要素投入的運輸成本上升。

en.text: The country's currency appreciates against the currencies of its trading partners.

zh.text: 相對於其貿易夥伴的貨幣，該國的貨幣升值。

en.text: Firms become optimistic about the economic prospect of the country.

zh.text: 廠商對該國的經濟前景感到樂觀。
香港中學文憑考試 2026 卷一 第 27 題

en.text: Suppose many factories in an economy are closed due to a massive labour strike. Which of the following may offset its effect on the economy's price level in the short run?

zh.text: 假設某經濟體系中許多工廠因大規模勞工罷工而倒閉。在短期內，下列哪項／些可能會抵銷其對該經濟體系物價水平的影響？

en.text: There is an economic recovery in the economy's major trading partner.

zh.text: 該經濟體系的主要貿易夥伴經濟復蘇。

en.text: There is an increase in people's desire to save.
There is an increase in oil prices.

en.text: The initial equilibrium point of the economy is at E
. If the new long run equilibrium point is at E
, which of the following are possible reasons for the above change in the long run equilibrium point?

zh.text: 該經濟最初的均衡點是 E0。若新的長期均衡點是 E1，下列哪項／些是上述長期均衡點變動的可能原因？

en.text: The government constructs more new universities to increase the number of higher education places.

zh.text: 政府興建更多新大學以增加高等教育學額。

en.text: The government discovers a new oil field and begins extraction of crude oil.

zh.text: 政府發現新油田並開始開採原油。

en.text: The government increases the wages of civil servants.

zh.text: 政府提高公務員的工資。
